# couchbase-capella_cloud_accounts (Data Source)

The data source to retrieve Capella's cloud accounts for an organization, to grant them access in your own cloud account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella_cloud_accounts" "existing_cloud_accounts" {
  organization_id = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `aws_capella_account` (String) - The AWS account ID.
- `azure_capella_subscription` (String) - The Azure subscription name.
- `azure_capella_subscription_id` (String)
- `gcp_capella_project` (String) - The GCP project name.
